announcements.title: ARC Market Update
announcements.content:
Several hours ago, we moved the ARC market to operate under a capped strategy with ~$100K USDC in allocated capital (LLP Strategies). If LLP liquidity is fully depleted, the market will transition to ADL to ensure orderly risk resolution. We work to find the right balance between protecting LLP and maintaining fair, efficient conditions for traders.

Edit: ARC does not have its own LLP strategy. It is currently sharing one with one other market, and using most of the collateral.
